message: 魔王への憧れ
Well then, off to the Student Council room in high spirits today too--

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun, Synn-kun. Ria-senpai is calling for you~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You sure are popular~」

name: Synn
message: 「It's nothing like that」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Good thing Nana-chan isn't here, huh~」

name: Synn
message: 「Why? Where did Nanaka go?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If you ask me multiple questions at once, my head's gonna explode~」

name: Synn
message: 「Never mind, then. Thanks, Sacchin」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, Synn-kun. Sorry, I have something I wanted to talk to you about」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm heading to the Student Council room right now, though」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um. Somewhere with as few people around as possible would be better, I think」
W-What could this be, my heart's pounding.
Come to think of it, Ria-senpai has been acting strange lately, so... could this possibly be a super important talk!?
When it comes to that, I can't help getting my hopes up.
After all, if we're going to talk alone together--

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun... Do you, right now... have someone you like, or anything?」
Here it coooooomes.

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's...」
Aah, I'm so nervous the words won't come out.

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be...」
Ooooooooh.

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be that you're in love with my big sister!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaaat!?」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Wha--」

name: Synn
message: 「How did you jump to that conclusion?! That I like Helena-san...」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, I don't dislike her!! It's just the age gap, and besides, Helena-san doesn't pay me any mind at all...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, how on earth could you look at me and think I'm in love with Helena-san?!」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm sorry!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... aah!! Sorry, I just...」
No good, no good, I ended up raising my voice without thinking.

name: Synn
message: 「Um... let me ask again. Ria-senpai, why did you misunderstand and think I liked Helena-san?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because, Synn-kun... When my big sister talked about the Demon Lord before, you looked super disappointed...」

name: Ria
message: 「And then you tried to become her type of guy...!」
Could she mean when I was trying to act like a cool, slightly bad-boy type?

name: Synn
message: 「No, no! That's really not why I did that!」

name: Ria
message: 「Then why?」
Urgh... I really can't tell her it was literally just because I wanted to seem more like a proper Demon Lord...

name: Synn
message: 「A-A-Anyway! Thinking I like Helena-san is a huge misunderstanding!」

name: Ria
message: 「I see...」
Ria-senpai let out a big sigh.

name: Ria
message: 「Even if you want to be like the Demon Lord, it's not something you can just easily pull off... Synn-kun, you're totally fine just being yourself.」
Well, I actually am the Demon Lord, though.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, having actually tried pretending to be the Demon Lord... I realized it's just not for me.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Just staying the way you are really is best, Synn-kun\s04」
Is she trying to cheer me up? Though it's not like Senpai knows I'm the Demon Lord when she says that...

name: Ria
message: 「Still... I really do understand how my big sister feels about admiring the Demon Lord, you know.」

name: Ria
message: 「Because I--」

name: Ria
message: 「I admire the Demon Lord too.」

name: Ria
message: 「Did you just think, 'They really are sisters'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, no...」
I thought Helena-san was the only playful one, so Ria-senpai has that side to her too.

name: Ria
message: 「I mean, any girl would admire them, right? Someone cool who'd save the world...」
The 'Demon King' saving the world? Isn't that mistaking it for 'Love'?
Still, to think not just Helena-san, but even Ria-senpai looks up to the Demon King...
